records.Original Comment:
Please Add Index Holdings Sorted by Weightage or Market Cap: The application is very user-friendly! I would like to suggest a useful feature: when users open any stock market index, such as Nifty 50 or Sensex, please display its constituent stocks sorted by index weightage or market capitalization.

It would be very helpful to have an option to sort the holdings by either index weightage (%) or market capitalization, so users can easily identify the stocks that have the biggest influence on the index.

This feature would make it much easier for investors to understand index composition and analyze the market. I hope the Groww team considers adding this feature in a future update.

Thank you for building such a great app!

records.Original Comment:
Changing user interface: Before joining Groww, I tried several trading platforms, but I chose Groww because I genuinely loved its user interface (UI/UX). Unfortunately, the user experience is getting worse with every unnecessary change. The sidebar has disappeared from the stock chart view, making navigation less convenient.

Please don’t turn Groww into another Facebook or Instagram. Users come to Groww to invest, analyse charts, and trade—not to experience a social-media-style interface.

The simplicity and functionality of Groww were its biggest strengths. Please bring back the sidebar in the chart view and prioritise the needs of traders and investors over unnecessary UI changes.

Don’t fix what isn’t broken. Bring back the interface that made us love Groww in the first place.

Very good experience: I have been a Groww customer since past more than 5 years and I am very satisfied with Groww - wonderful interface, ease of use, prompt support. Recently I saw that Groww has introduced global investing through US stocks and US based ETFs. This is a good option for global diversification considering investment through mutual fund route is almost closed since early 2022.

It was my suggestion to Groww’s team to introduce UCITS ETF (ETFs which are not US based) since this would avoid high withholding tax on dividend as well as Estate tax imposed by US. Also, dividends of UCITS are reinvested automatically inside the Fund. Platforms such as IndMoney do offer UCITS ETF. Since Groww is a very progressive organisation and takes pride in always keeping its ears to the ground and giving customer satisfaction highest importance, I hope Groww team takes note of this suggestion.

records.Original Comment:
One of the most pathetic experiences I have ever had with a financial platform.: Groww looks impressive until you actually need help. The moment there is a serious issue involving your money, the so-called “customer support” becomes an endless cycle of useless automated replies, copy-pasted messages and absolutely zero accountability.

It is honestly frustrating to see a financial platform put so much effort into making the app look smooth while seemingly putting so little effort into actually helping customers when something goes wrong.

You don’t feel like a customer—you feel like a ticket number being passed around by a system that doesn’t care whether your problem gets resolved or not.

When money is involved, “please wait” and generic replies are NOT customer service.

The entire experience has been unbelievably frustrating, time-consuming and disappointing. If you expect quick resolution, proper communication and someone to actually take ownership of your issue, don’t expect much from Groww.

I seriously regret choosing this platform. A financial service should give customers confidence and peace of mind—not make them constantly worry about whether their issue will ever be resolved.

Groww needs a reality check. A good-looking app cannot compensate for terrible support and a frustrating customer experience.

I would not recommend Groww based on my experience. There are better alternatives where customers deserve to be treated like customers.
